branchName.instructions: Use <type>/<short-kebab-case-description> in English. Choose type from feat, fix, docs, chore, ci, refactor, or test.

commitMessage.instructions: Use Conventional Commits with a scope: <type>(<scope>): <short description>. Write in English, in imperative mood, with no trailing period; keep the entire message within 72 characters. Choose a concise scope that reflects the changed area of the repository.

pullRequest.instructions: Write the title and body in English. Use a concise Conventional Commits title with a relevant scope. Start the body with a Summary and include a Test plan section. List only checks actually performed and their results; mark unperformed checks as Not run. Describe relevant behavior, compatibility, configuration, or data impact and rollout or rollback requirements when applicable. Never include secrets or sensitive data. Creating or updating a PR does not authorize merging; keep it open unless the user explicitly requests merging it.
